quests.title: First Light
quests.description: Use Ampere and the relics' resonance to light all five large relics at once.

quests.title: String Them Together
quests.description: Use Weave and the small relay relics to carry the five relics' power into Stella's magical item.

quests.title: Out of Alignment
quests.description: Finish Cinna Cirra’s Vis lesson, lift the orientation relic beside the C02 terrace and carry it through the ice-trial portal on the campus path at (47,45). Set it on the empty stand inside, then return to Cinna on the terrace.

quests.title: Cold Feet, Warm Idea
quests.description: Enter Cinna Cirra’s ice trial through the portal on the campus path at (47,45) and finish their Glaciate lesson. Freeze the pool at the relic you set on its stand, slide onto all twelve switches until every one is lit, then slide into the seal in the east wall. Glaciate is yours to keep once the seal opens.

quests.title: Patch Notes
quests.description: Finish Orio's Rotara lesson, then cast Rotara at the sockets of the rune dais in the deep forest until all three disc rotations reach zero and the runes shine.

quests.title: Three Lost Echoes
quests.description: Use Lost Echoes to recover Katrina's three memory anchors from the Library, the sakura garden and the forest stream, then return them to her. Lost Echoes is yours to keep once all three are returned.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Between two old volumes, you recover Katrina’s brass bookmark. Tiny corrections cover its edge—as if she has been arguing with the authors.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: A silver ribbon answers the echo beneath the sakura petals. Its embroidery shows three constellations stitched slightly crooked.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Beside the stream, you find a riverglass chime. Even in your hand, it hums in time with the water.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: I'm working on a magical item, but something has gone wrong—the circuit is broken.

choices.text: Remind me how the relics work.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: It won't move without power. This item is unusual: five relics have to supply it together.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: I'll teach you Ampere. Cast it on a large relic to change its charge.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: The relics resonate, so one cast may change several. Make all five glow at once, then come back to me.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Use Ampere on the five large relics. Their resonance links their states.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Watch which relics change and find the sequence that leaves all five glowing together.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Good—the five relics are holding a shared charge.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Now we have to carry that power into the magical item. I'll teach you Weave for the second part.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: The five large relics are ready. The last step is connecting their shared power to the magical item.

choices.text: Teach me how to connect them.
Remind me how Weave carries power.
The magical item is moving again.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: I'll teach you Weave. It carries energy between connected relics, but its range is limited.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Use the smaller relics as relays. Begin at a glowing large relic, then weave through nearby small relics.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Connect every large relic and the magical item into one live circuit. A small relic glows only while it has power.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Cast Weave on a glowing large relic to hold a thread, then cast it on a nearby small relay.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Continue from relay to relay within range. A relay goes dark if its cable to powered relics is cut.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Connect all five large relics and the magical item into the same live network.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: That's it—the five relics are feeding the same circuit, and the magical item is active again.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Thank you. The repair is complete.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: I registered for orientation duty because it sounded welcoming. It is apparently for students who already know how half these objects work.

choices.text: The relic is on the trial stand.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: One of the orientation relics belongs in the ice trial, and it is far too heavy for me. Let me teach you Vis. Finish this lesson, then stand beside the relic and cast Vis to lift it. Carry it through the trial portal on the campus path at (47,45) and set it on the empty stand inside. You can only put it down on open ground, and if you wander into a building it settles back where you last left it.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Lift the relic beside me with Vis, carry it through the trial portal on the campus path at (47,45), then face the empty stand inside and cast Vis again to set it down. If you lose track of it, press R near it on the terrace to bring it back. Come and tell me once it is on the stand.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: It is on the stand already? Then the trial can finally open. I will go ahead and get it ready. Meet me at the ice trial, through the portal on the campus path.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: The relic is on its stand and the trial is ready. I thought preparation meant knowing everything already, but asking for help taught me more quickly.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Every switch lit and the seal answered. You read the ice instead of guessing at it, so Glaciate is yours to keep.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: This is the last orientation trial: twelve switches set into a pool, and a seal in the east wall that opens only when every switch is lit. I would prefer not to discover the wrong route with my feet.

choices.text: Let’s find a safe way through.
What do we know so far?

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Then I will lend you Glaciate for the trial. Cast it on the relic you carried in, on its stand beside the pool, and the water freezes solid. On ice you slide until you land on a switch, reach the entrance or stop against a wall, so you cannot turn halfway. Landing on a switch lights it and landing on it again dims it. Light all twelve, then slide into the seal. If the count goes wrong, press R and the switches reset.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Twelve switches and one seal. You only stop on a switch, at the entrance or against a wall, and every landing flips the switch beneath you. Follow the lines between the switches, and press R to reset if the count goes wrong. Cast Glaciate on the relic again if you want the pool back to water.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: The seal opened and you came through dry. Cold feet became a warm idea once we watched each slide instead of treating the pool as a dare. Glaciate is yours to keep.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Welcome to the mechanism glade. My rune dais in the deep forest is a few turns off.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Rotara turns things clockwise by 90 degrees.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: My rune dais is in the deep forest, through the portal just west of here.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Its four sockets each turn every disc they touch. Choose Rotara, stand by a socket and cast.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: The dais will confirm the repair when all three disc rotations return to zero.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: A socket never turns just one disc, so watch which discs each one moves.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Each cast adds 90 degrees to every disc that socket touches.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Four casts on one socket put its discs back where they started.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: The dais is aligned and the sequence finally behaves.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: A practical check was better than rebuilding the whole solution in my head.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: I need three things recovered. Before you ask: no, I did not simply drop them while walking.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: I was calibrating Lost Echoes with three personal memory anchors.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: The echoes crossed. The spell preserved every memory except my memory of where I placed the anchors.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: A brass bookmark went to the Library, where written memories gather.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: A silver ribbon went beneath the sakura trees, for memories tied to people and places.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: A riverglass chime went beside the forest stream, to measure echoes that never stay still.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: I’ll lend you Lost Echoes. Cast within four cells of an anchor, then approach and collect it.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Recover all three and bring them back. If you manage that, the spell is yours.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Which part of the trail do you want to retrace?

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Search among the Library shelves. The brass bookmark should answer near old books.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Search beneath the sakura trees. The ribbon may be hidden under fallen petals.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Follow the forest stream. The chime should resonate with moving water.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Text remembers what was written, gardens remember who lingered, and water remembers only motion. I needed all three kinds of echo.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: The bookmark, the ribbon, and the chime. You found the entire trail my spell erased.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: I called them calibration anchors. Truthfully, I chose things I would miss enough to search for properly.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Keep Lost Echoes. You understand it better than I did when I began the experiment.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Next time I test memory magic, I am writing the locations down first.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: On paper. With a duplicate copy kept very far from the spell.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: Hey, {player}! Settling in all right?

choices.text: Can you remind me of the campus buildings and areas?

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: Sure! The fountain sits right in the middle of the courtyard. If you ever get lost, head back there.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: The grand one is the Main Academy Building: reception, the main portal and most of the staff.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: The Arcane Workshop is where the engineering lot tinker with relics and machines. Mind the sparks.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: The Dormitory is where students live, and the Library is for studying. Or napping between the shelves.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: And back through the gate is the forest, where you came in.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: Every building has a sign by its door, so follow the signs and you won't go far wrong.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: See you around!

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The lantern trail is easy to follow in daylight. At dusk, every tree starts looking like a landmark.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The forest threshold is close enough to campus that I can practise a spell and still hear the gate bell.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: If you find the brook overlook, listen before you cast. The quiet is part of the place.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Someone moved the cushions again. I respect the commitment to rearranging the common room every afternoon.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The quickest route to a study group is usually following whoever is carrying three books and a snack.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: I heard a Spellio match decided by one tiny turn. Games here are apparently serious research.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: The commons is the only place where every route across campus seems to cross at once.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: The orientation terrace is busy today. I hope someone remembered the schedule.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Lanterns make the forest trail look welcoming, even when the woods are being dramatic.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: I saw a new trail marker near the clearing. Or perhaps I saw the old one from a different angle.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: The common room is quiet for almost five minutes after breakfast. It is a remarkable campus record.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: A good study plan includes a break, a second break, and finding out what everyone else is playing.

events.description: All five resonating relics are glowing; return to Stella for the Weave stage.
All large relics, relay relics and Stella's magical item share a live circuit.
Fired when Cinna leaves for the ice trial, after the orientation relic is on its stand and the player has reported back.
Puzzle callback after every ice-trial switch is lit and the seal in the east wall opens.
Puzzle callback after Orio's mechanism reaches its intended configuration.
The brass bookmark was recovered from the Library.
The silver ribbon was recovered from the sakura garden.
The riverglass chime was recovered beside the forest stream.
All three of Katrina's memory anchors have been recovered.
Completion when the player returns all three memory anchors to Katrina.
